{"title":"California EDD: Ongoing claim management + bi-weekly certification system","content":"## Objective
Set up a reliable, repeatable system to (1) manage an existing California EDD unemployment claim and (2) complete bi-weekly certifications on time to avoid payment delays.

## Approach (reduce uncertainty → reduce remaining work)
1. **Confirm the official EDD rules and timing** for when/how to certify and what triggers delays.
2. **Build a reminder workflow** (calendar + redundant reminders) aligned to the EDD certification window.
3. **Create a certification checklist** (questions, common pitfalls, what info to gather beforehand).
4. **Synthesize into a one-page operating playbook** you can follow every two weeks.

## Notes / boundaries
- This plan avoids logging into your EDD account via an automated browser flow; instead it creates a dependable process you can execute in your own UI Online session.
